lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਨਾਹੀ ਖਸਮੈ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)dak kee gat katahoo(n) naahee khasamai evai bhaanaa ||
lines.translation: The slanderer shall never attain emancipation; this is the Will of the Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦ ਕਰੇ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਤਿਉ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jo jo ni(n)d kare sa(n)tan kee tiu sa(n)tan sukh maanaa ||3||
lines.translation: The more the Saints are slandered, the more they dwell in peace. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਟੇਕ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)taa tek tumaaree suaamee too(n) sa(n)tan kaa sahaaee ||
lines.translation: The Saints have Your Support, O Lord and Master; You are the Saints' Help and Support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਦੀਏ ਰੁੜਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੪੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak sa(n)t har raakhe ni(n)dak deee ruRaaee ||4||2||41||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, the Saints are saved by the Lord; the slanderers are drowned in the deep. ||4||2||41||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰੁ ਧੋਇ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਦੁਇ ਠਉਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਖੋਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: baahar dhoi a(n)tar man mailaa dui thaur apune khoe ||
lines.translation: He washes outwardly, but within, his mind is filthy; thus he loses his place in both worlds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਈਹਾ ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਆਗੈ ਮੁਸਿ ਮੁਸਿ ਰੋਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: eehaa kaam krodh mohi viaapiaa aagai mus mus roe ||1||
lines.translation: Here, he is engrossed in sexual desire, anger and emotional attachment; hereafter, he shall sigh and weep. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਭਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਹੋਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: govi(n)d bhajan kee mat hai horaa ||
lines.translation: The way to vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the Universe is different.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਰਮੀ ਮਾਰੀ ਸਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਰਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸੁਨਈ ਡੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: varamee maaree saap na maraee naam na sunaee doraa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Destroying the snake-hole, the snake is not killed; the deaf person does not hear the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਵਾਈ ਭਗਤੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa kee kirat chhod gavaaee bhagatee saar na jaanai ||
lines.translation: He renounces the affairs of Maya, but he does not appreciate the value of devotional worship.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਉ ਤਰਕਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਤੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bed saasatr kau tarakan laagaa tat jog na pachhaanai ||2||
lines.translation: He finds fault with the Vedas and the Shaastras, and does not know the essence of Yoga. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਘਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਜੈਸਾ ਖੋਟਾ ਢਬੂਆ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਰਾਫਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ughar gaiaa jaisaa khotaa dhabooaa nadar saraaphaa aaiaa ||
lines.translation: He stands exposed, like a counterfeit coin, when inspected by the Lord, the Assayer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਉਸ ਤੇ ਕਹਾ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee sabh kichh jaanai us te kahaa chhapaaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows everything; how can we hide anything from Him? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਿ ਕਪਟਿ ਬੰਚਿ ਨਿੰਮੁਨੀਆਦਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਇਆ ਤਤਕਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooR kapat ba(n)ch ni(n)muneeaadaa binas gaiaa tatakaale ||
lines.translation: Through falsehood, fraud and deceit, the mortal collapses in an instant - he has no foundation at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਅਪਨੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਖੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੪੨॥
lines.transliteration: sat sat sat naanak kahiaa apanai hiradai dekh samaale ||4||3||42||
lines.translation: Truly, truly, truly, Nanak speaks; look within your own heart, and realize this. ||4||3||42||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਤ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਚੈ ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: udam karat hovai man niramal naachai aap nivaare ||
lines.translation: Making the effort, the mind becomes pure; in this dance, the self is silenced.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ਲੇ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch janaa le vasagat raakhai man mahi eka(n)kaare ||1||
lines.translation: The five passions are kept under control, and the One Lord dwells in the mind. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa jan nirat kare gun gaavai ||
lines.translation: Your humble servant dances and sings Your Glorious Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਬਾਬੁ ਪਖਾਵਜ ਤਾਲ ਘੁੰਘਰੂ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: rabaab pakhaavaj taal ghu(n)gharoo anahad sabad vajaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He plays upon the guitar, tambourine and cymbals, and the unstruck sound current of the Shabad resounds. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਬੋਧੈ ਅਪਨਾ ਪਾਛੈ ਅਵਰ ਰੀਝਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: prathame man parabodhai apanaa paachhai avar reejhaavai ||
lines.translation: First, he instructs his own mind, and then, he leads others.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਪੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਾਪੈ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਸਗਲ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam jap hiradai jaapai mukh te sagal sunaavai ||2||
lines.translation: He chants the Lord's Name and meditates on it in his heart; with his mouth, he announces it to all. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਰੈ ਸੰਤ ਧੂਰਿ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar sa(n)g saadhoo charan pakhaarai sa(n)t dhoor tan laavai ||
lines.translation: He joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and washes their feet; he applies the dust of the Saints to his body

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਸਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: man tan arap dhare gur aagai sat padaarath paavai ||3||
lines.translation: He surrenders his mind and body, and places them before the Guru; thus, he obtains the true wealth. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੁਨੈ ਪੇਖੈ ਲਾਇ ਸਰਧਾ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jo sunai pekhai laai saradhaa taa kaa janam maran dukh bhaagai ||
lines.translation: Whoever listens to, and beholds the Guru with faith, shall see his pains of birth and death taken away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੪॥੪॥੪੩॥
lines.transliteration: aisee nirat narak nivaarai naanak guramukh jaagai ||4||4||43||
lines.translation: Such a dance eliminates hell; O Nanak, the Gurmukh remains wakeful. ||4||4||43||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਧਮ ਚੰਡਾਲੀ ਭਈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣੀ ਸੂਦੀ ਤੇ ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: adham cha(n)daalee bhaee brahamanee soodee te sresataaee re ||
lines.translation: The lowly outcaste becomes a Brahmin, and the untouchable sweeper becomes pure and sublime.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਆਕਾਸੀ ਸਖਨੀ ਲਹਬਰ ਬੂਝੀ ਖਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: paataalee aakaasee sakhanee lahabar boojhee khaaee re ||1||
lines.translation: The burning desire of the nether regions and the etheric realms is finally quenched and extinguished. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਕੀ ਬਿਲਾਈ ਅਵਰ ਸਿਖਾਈ ਮੂਸਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਡਰਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar kee bilaaee avar sikhaaee moosaa dekh daraaee re ||
lines.translation: The house-cat has been taught otherwise, and is terrified upon seeing the mouse.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਜ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਕੇਹਰਿ ਕੂਕਰ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aj kai vas gur keeno kehar kookar tinahi lagaaee re ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Guru has put the tiger under the control of the sheep, and now, the dog eats grass. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਝੁ ਥੂਨੀਆ ਛਪਰਾ ਥਾਮੑਿਆ ਨੀਘਰਿਆ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: baajh thooneeaa chhaparaa thaamhiaa neeghariaa ghar paaiaa re ||
lines.translation: Without pillars, the roof is supported, and the homeless have found a home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਜੜੀਏ ਲੈ ਜੜਿਓ ਜੜਾਵਾ ਥੇਵਾ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bin jaReee lai jaRio jaRaavaa thevaa acharaj laaiaa re ||2||
lines.translation: Without the jeweller, the jewel has been set, and the wonderful stone shines forth. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਦੀ ਦਾਦਿ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰਾ ਚੂਪੀ ਨਿਰਨਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: daadee daad na pahuchanahaaraa choopee niranau paaiaa re ||
lines.translation: The claimant does not succeed by placing his claim, but by keeping silent, he obtains justice.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਲਿ ਦੁਲੀਚੈ ਬੈਠੀ ਲੇ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਨੈਨ ਦਿਖਾਲਨੁ ਧਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: maal duleechai baithee le miratak nain dikhaalan dhaaiaa re ||3||
lines.translation: The dead sit on costly carpets, and what is seen with the eyes shall vanish. ||3||
